body:
Stacked on #2 (edge-nl-graph). Closes the deferred item from the 12:23 pulse: worker.ts TS port + automated parity runner.

## What
- **edge/worker.ts** — replaces the 0.560 keyword table with a TS mirror of the canonical router (edge/nl_route.js). Imports the SAME edge/synonym_graph.json — structural data parity, no copied table. Exports `routePrompt(graph, prompt)` for pinning. Fetch handler now returns routed_class/route_score/route_hits alongside active_ledger_delta.
- **tools/nl_parity.js** — zero-dep automated parity runner (node >= 22, native type stripping). Runs both routers over all 50 pinned eval prompts, compares class+dials+score+hits, exits 1 on divergence. `--receipt` seals sha256s.
- **tools/nl_parity_receipt.json** — sealed receipt.

## FAIL-first
Runner tripped RED against the old worker.ts (no routePrompt export — mirror was not the graph router), GREEN 50/50 after the port.

## Verification
```
$ node tools/nl_parity.js
parity 50/50 identical (class+dials+score+hits)
```
Fetch smoke: 'heavy woodcut carving, but make it soft' → routed_class=soft via but-pivot (score 3 = 2.0×1.5), matching canonical semantics.

## Honest scope
Parity pins behavior on the pre-registered 50-prompt set only; it is not a proof of equivalence on arbitrary strings. Wrangler deploy config untouched.
title: edge NL: worker.ts TS mirror of graph router + automated parity runner (50/50 pinned)
